# Frozen E0 metadata test inputs

These are the original outcome-blind artifacts from the existing Market Memory evidence at `science/l0/`, created before evaluation admission. They are copied byte-for-byte so the resolver can exercise their actual JSON and Markdown representations, including the bare guide digest and seed in the pre-label binding.

The membership artifact contains the already-frozen 109 index/receipt joins and metadata only. Its source measurement sessions, episode assignments, feature spans and label spans remain null. It is not an operational population, reviewer plan, study allocation or label capability. Tests construct a synthetic control envelope around these bytes and never treat it as a real registration.

The protocol remains the existing `research/market_memory/RETRIEVAL_PROTOCOL_2026_10_12.json`; it is not duplicated here. Exact artifact and membership digests are checked by the resolver. No private-store or outcome-label read produced these fixtures in this change.

The pre-label binding is passed as an explicit diagnostic byte input. It is never bound to the registration reviewer-plan reference. Missing reviewer assignments and condition allocation remain unresolved.
